content.short: Nillion is a revolutionary decentralized network for blind computation and secure storage using privacy technologies.
content.description: Nillion is a revolutionary decentralized network designed for secure computation and storage, utilizing advanced Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs) like Multi-Party Computation (MPC). Unlike traditional blockchains, Nillion focuses on "Blind Computation," allowing the network to process encrypted data without ever decrypting it. This ensures that sensitive information remains completely private while still enabling complex processing and storage across a globally distributed network. Designed for high-value data and privacy-centric applications, Nillion provides a foundational layer for decentralized identity, AI, and secure communication, powered by the NIL token and independent consensus.
